label: Whatever is present at a moment of a history is in act as to being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, whatever is present at some moment is in act in the esse respect (InAct x esse). The history-level counterpart of the world-level selected-world contract 0436de86 (ExistingInActAt); neither is derived from the other. It lets 'causes the being of everything else in act as to being' reach everything present at a moment.
